poll.question: Dusk is falling and the moans are rising from the streets. Dan's hands tense on the ramp hinges as the old fear pulls him back toward sealed-tight control. Hui Ling stand

options.label: Seal it shut
options.desc: He's come far today. One night of mercy.

options.label: Keep it open
options.desc: He's holding it. Don't let dusk undo him.

in_play.label: Let him go
in_play.desc: She stays with Mari. She trusts him. The ramp closes behind him.
